{{Quote|Family is more than blood. I don't want to have to shoot you—but to protect my family, I will.|[[Koblus Sornell|Ko Sornell]]|<ref name="War3">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 3|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Clan Sornell''' was a clan of predominantly [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] in existence during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Clan Sornell was comprised of the Mandalorian couple [[Koblus Sornell|Koblus "Ko" Sornell]] and her husband [[Haarm Sornell|Haarm]], along with their son [[Gheedor Sornell|Gheedor]], a younger [[Koblus Sornell's daughter|daughter]], and an [[Koblus Sornell's infant son|infant]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]].<ref name="War2" />

The members of Clan Sornell had all rallied to the call of [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] and joined the growing [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]] movement as the Mandalorians set out to conquer the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="War2" /> By the height of the Mandalorian Wars, Ko Sornell had begun to train her son Gheedor in the Mandalorian ways, taking him into combat with her atop a [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] during the [[Essien landing|battle]] on [[Essien]].<ref name="War1">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 1|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 1]]</ref>

The members of Clan Sornell took part in the Mandalorians' [[Battle of Halthor|victory]] at [[Halthor]], and in its wake, Haarm Sornell and his daughter erected their family's [[Clan Sornell's house|portable home]]. There, the clan ate [[bile-rat stew|dinner]] in the company of captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-Mandalorian conscript [[Zayne Carrick]], and the Republic [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dallan Morvis]], before shipping out for [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to capture the [[Jedi Enclave]] and the numerous [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi younglings]] there.<ref name="War3" /> During the course of the attack on Dantooine, Ko Sornell revealed that she was currently [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]] with another child.<ref name="War4">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 4|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 4]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Koblus Sornell was first featured in the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive short story, ''[[Interference]]'', by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[John Jackson Miller]]. However, it was only with Miller's ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: War]]'' five-part miniseries that Clan Sornell was officially introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], debuting the characters of Haarm, Gheedor, and two other unnamed Sornell children. The [[Knights of the Old Republic: War 5|final issue]] also revealed that Koblus Sornell was pregnant, and expecting another child.
